notes.title: Notes
notes.zoom_desc: Use the slider or pinch gesture to zoom in on a video fragment. Drag the view to pan.
notes.goal_desc: Aim for the narrowest curve possible – this means consistent reaction times. Avoid predicting!
notes.install_desc:
iOS: Share → Add to Home Screen
Android/Desktop: Menu → Install

instructions.step1_desc: Select video file(s) from disk or paste a URL. You can add multiple videos at once.
instructions.step2_desc: Scroll to the frame you want to react to and press
instructions.step3_desc: Press or click Start. React with the button when you see the event.
instructions.footer: Goal: react quickly, but don't predict!
